UKHC010199092026
WPMS/3437/2026
Shri Mudit Ghildiyal
--Petitioner
 Versus
Vinod Ghildiyal Deceased
--Respondent
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Suryakant Maithani, learned counsel for the
petitioner. 
2. Petitioner, herein, filed a suit for partition in the
year 2000 and a preliminary decree was passed on
06.04.2012 but final decree has yet not been passed.
3. It is very surprising that preliminary decree was
passed on 06.04.2012 but final decree has not been
passed even after lapse of 14 years. 
4. Let Registry may get necessary instructions from
the learned Civil Judge, (Senior Division), Kotdwar,
District Pauri Garhwal, on an administrative side on
the above aspect as well as about the status of pending
application moved under Order 39 Rule 2 (A) of the
Code of Civil Procedure on the next date fixed.
5. List on 18.11.2026.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 05.11.2026
SKS

Along with connected matter
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Suryakant Maithani, learned 
counsel for the petitioner.
2. A specific report was asked on 
administrative side from the concerned Civil 
Judge (Sr. Div.), Kotdwar, District Pauri 
Garhwal that if the preliminary decree was
passed on 06.04.2012 why the final decree 
has not been passed even after lapse of 14 
years. There is no response to this query. It 
appears that the concerned Judge is 
avoiding the query of this Court.
3. Let the Registry may get fresh report 
from the concerned Court.
4. List this case on 23.11.2026.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
